subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on August 15th. Your flight details are as follows: - Flight number: XY123 - Departure time: 10:00 AM - Arrival time: 2:00 PM Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our airline. Best regards, The Airline Team
